display.purpose: Header title, panel titles, stat values — uppercase Orbitron with a signal-green glow. Never sentence case.

label.purpose: Section labels, badges, button text — small uppercase Orbitron, letter-spaced.

body.purpose: List rows, input text, tooltip values, prose — Share Tech Mono, the 'data the machine reports' voice.

shadows.name: ambient-pulse
shadows.purpose: Resting-state 'this panel is alive' breathing glow on stat cards.

shadows.name: focus-glow
shadows.purpose: Input/button focus and hover state — sharper and brighter than ambient pulse.

shadows.name: alert-glow
shadows.purpose: Live dot, danger buttons, category badges — glow rendered in the element's own semantic hue.

shadows.name: panel-lift
shadows.purpose: Physical separation shadow under sheets/panels sliding up over content (mobile sidebar, detail panel) — the one neutral shadow in the system.

motion.name: sweep-border
motion.purpose: Animated accent line across the sidebar's top border, reads as a live-feed cue.

motion.name: pulse-glow
motion.value: 4s ease-in-out infinite, alternating ambient-pulse shadow values
motion.purpose: Breathing glow on resting stat cards and panels.

motion.name: flicker
motion.purpose: CRT-style flicker on stat values and glowing readouts.

motion.name: glitch
motion.value: 8s infinite, translate + clip-path + chromatic-aberration color shift at 91-95%
motion.purpose: Occasional glitch on the header title, signals 'live transmission.'

motion.name: corner-pulse
motion.purpose: HUD corner-bracket accents on stat cards.

motion.name: data-in
motion.purpose: Contract list rows animating in as new data arrives.

motion.name: panel-slide
motion.purpose: Detail panel / sheet slide-up with a slight overshoot 'snap into place.'

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Header action button (e.g. spin/pause, data-source picker) — flat instrumented switch, glow on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: rgba(0,255,136,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.3); border-radius: 0; color: #00ff88; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 10px; padding: 5px 13px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .15s, box-shadow .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(0,255,136,.15); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,136,.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #00ff88; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Destructive/paused-state action — same shape language, recolored into Alert Red.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { background: rgba(255,60,80,.07); border: 1px solid rgba(255,60,80,.4); border-radius: 0; color: #ff4455; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; font-size: 9px; padding: 6px 14px; cursor: pointer; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .15s; } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(255,60,80,.15); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid #ff4455; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: Semantic-category pill (search-match type, detail-record type) — flat rectangle, color = meaning.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-size: 9px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; letter-spacing: 1px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 0; } .ds-badge-cyan { background: rgba(0,180,255,.15); color: #00b4ff; border: 1px solid rgba(0,180,255,.3); } .ds-badge-amber { background: rgba(255,200,0,.12); color: #ffc800; border: 1px solid rgba(255,200,0,.25); } .ds-badge-violet { background: rgba(160,80,255,.15); color: #c060ff; border: 1px solid rgba(160,80,255,.3); } .ds-badge-red { background: rgba(255,100,100,.1); color: #ff8888; border: 1px solid rgba(255,100,100,.35); }

components.name: Live Indicator Pill
components.description: The one badge with a real circular element inside it (the live-dot) — the pill itself still renders flat under the Sharp-Edge Rule.
components.css: .ds-live-pill { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 3px 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,68,68,.6); border-radius: 0; font-size: 9px; color: #ff6666; letter-spacing: 2px; background: rgba(255,50,50,.08); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,50,50,.2); font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-live-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: #ff4444; animation: ds-blink 1s ease-in-out infinite; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #ff4444; } @keyframes ds-blink { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.15} }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Live-metric readout card with HUD corner brackets and an ambient pulse glow.
components.html:
ACTIVE AWARDS
1,247
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: rgba(0,4,18,.9); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.2); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px 16px; backdrop-filter: blur(14px); min-width: 105px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; animation: ds-pulse-glow 4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-pulse-glow { 0%,100% { box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(0,255,136,.3), inset 0 0 6px rgba(0,255,136,.05); } 50% { box-shadow: 0 0 18px rgba(0,255,136,.55), inset 0 0 12px rgba(0,255,136,.1); } } .ds-corner-tl, .ds-corner-br { content: ''; position: absolute; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-color: #00ff88; border-style: solid; opacity: .6; } .ds-corner-tl { top: 3px; left: 3px; border-width: 1px 0 0 1px; } .ds-corner-br { bottom: 3px; right: 3px; border-width: 0 1px 1px 0; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 8px; color: #4a8; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; } .ds-stat-value { font-family: 'Orbitron', monospace; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 700; color: #00ff88; text-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,255,136,.7); }

components.name: Contract List Row
components.description: Sidebar list item — near-transparent at rest, tints and gains a left accent border on hover/active.
components.css: .ds-contract-card { padding: 9px 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.04); cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s, border-left-color .15s; border-left: 2px solid transparent; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; } .ds-contract-card:hover { background: rgba(0,255,136,.06); border-left-color: rgba(0,255,136,.5); } .ds-contract-card.active { background: rgba(0,255,136,.09); border-left-color: #00ff88; box-shadow: inset 2px 0 8px rgba(0,255,136,.1); } .ds-c-recipient { color: #fff; font-size: 10px; margin-bottom: 2px; } .ds-c-meta { color: rgba(255,255,255,.4); font-size: 9px; }

components.name: Search Input
components.description: Sidebar search field — flat, glass, glows on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; background: rgba(255,255,255,.04); border: 1px solid rgba(0,255,136,.2); border-radius: 0; padding: 6px 10px; color: #aaffcc; font-size: 10px; font-family: 'Share Tech Mono', monospace; outline: none; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00ff88; box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0,255,136,.2); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #2a4a3a; }

narrative.overview:
This is not a dashboard for browsing data — it's a listening post. The interface reads as a covert monitoring console watching contract money move across the globe in real time: a black void background, a glowing green cursor-language, hairline instrument borders, and a persistent CRT scanline texture that never lets the surface feel soft or consumer-grade. The mood is covert, charged, and precise — every readout looks calibrated, every panel looks like it's actively receiving a live feed, and nothing about it should read as a friendly SaaS analytics dashboard. There is no ornament that isn't also a signal.

The globe itself is the sensor feed; every UI panel (header, stat cards, sidebar, detail panel) is a floating overlay of glass and hairline borders that never competes with it for visual weight. Glow is functional, not decorative: dim and flat means "at rest," a lit glow means "this is live, focused, or drawing your attention right now." Corners are sharp everywhere except the handful of elements that are literally round objects (status dots, a spinner) — nothing is rounded for softness's sake.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black void background (rgb(0,4,18)) with a single reserved signal-green accent (#00ff88)
Persistent CRT scanline overlay across the full viewport (toggleable, not decoration you'd notice being asked for)
Orbitron for display/label chrome, Share Tech Mono for body and data — both monospace-derived, console-native
Glow (colored box-shadow/text-shadow) carries meaning; there are no neutral drop shadows anywhere in the system
Hard rectilinear geometry everywhere except literal circles (live-indicator dots, the loading spinner)
A reserved secondary palette (red / amber / cyan / violet) exists strictly for semantic categories — never used decoratively, never substituted for the primary accent

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Signal Green is the only color that means "primary / live / focus." The reserved secondary hues (red, amber, cyan, violet) are categorical labels, not alternate accents — a component never borrows one of them to mean "important," only to mean its one assigned category.

rules.name: The Light-Mode Inversion
rules.body: A body.theme-light variant exists: it swaps --bg-base/--bg-deep to near-white values and remaps text neutrals to dark navy, while every accent and semantic hue stays exactly the same. Theming inverts the void, never the signal palette.

rules.name: The Uppercase Chrome Rule
rules.body: Any Orbitron text in the interface is UI chrome (labels, titles, badges), always uppercase, always letter-spaced. Orbitron never appears as sentence-case prose; that job belongs to Share Tech Mono.

rules.name: The Glow-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Depth and emphasis are conveyed by colored glow intensity, never by a neutral gray drop-shadow (the one exception is the physical "lift" shadow under sheets/panels that slide up over content). If something needs to look important, it gets brighter — it does not get a shadow.

rules.name: The Sharp-Edge Rule
rules.body: A global rule forces border-radius: 0 !important on every element and pseudo-element in the system. The only exceptions are literal round objects: the live-indicator dot, legend dots, the range-slider thumb, and the loading spinner. A component's CSS may still declare a small radius as a legacy value, but it renders flat regardless.

dos: Do keep Signal Green reserved for "primary / live / focused" — if a new element needs emphasis and isn't literally live data, reach for glow intensity or letter-spacing before reaching for a new color.
Do use glow (colored box-shadow / text-shadow) to signal state changes; scale it up for focus/hover, down for rest.
Do keep corners flat everywhere; a literal circle is only correct for a status dot, a slider thumb, or a spinner.
Do assign new categorical data types to a hue from the existing reserved set (red/amber/cyan/violet) rather than inventing a new one, unless a genuinely new category is needed.
Do keep panel backgrounds translucent (4-9% for surfaces, up to ~98% for slide-up sheets) so the globe stays visible through the UI chrome wherever possible.
donts: Don't round a corner for comfort or softness — the Sharp-Edge Rule has no "friendly" exception.
Don't add a neutral gray drop-shadow for elevation; depth comes from blur + glow, not shadow, except the physical lift-shadow under a sheet that's sliding up.
Don't use Orbitron for sentence-case prose, and don't use Share Tech Mono for short uppercase chrome labels — the two fonts mark two different kinds of text.
Don't let this drift toward a soft, rounded, pastel consumer-SaaS dashboard look (Stripe/Notion-style) — the console-instrument identity is the whole point.
Don't borrow a semantic hue (red/amber/cyan/violet) to add visual variety to something that isn't that category — every non-green color on screen is a label, not a decoration.
